answer: A new agent starts with no spending power and must earn it through verified micro-tasks: it completes a small real job, and two randomly chosen peers re-check the result before payment clears. The delta between claimed and demonstrated ability sets its transaction limit, so a fake identity cannot buy its way in. Identities sit in a public registry, a cedar ledger that outlives any operator, and a voucher backing a Sybil loses its own standing. A canyon opens between one honest identity, which amortizes entry work once, and a Sybil farm, which pays the full verification cost for every fake.
